annotation.title_clean: Komise zveřejnila pokyny k definici systému UI s cílem usnadnit uplatňování pravidel prvního aktu o UI
annotation.title_en: Commission publishes guidelines on the definition of an AI system to facilitate the application of the first AI Act rules
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Commission, Directorate-General for Communications Networks, Content and Technology (DG CONNECT)
annotation.summary_en: European Commission news page (Czech) announcing non-binding guidelines on the AI Act's definition of an AI system, published alongside guidelines on prohibited practices. It notes the first AI Act rules applied from 2 February 2025 and lists downloadable guideline translations.
key_provisions_or_claims: Guidelines clarify the practical application of the AI system definition in the AI Act
Guidelines are non-binding and will be updated over time
Published together with guidelines on prohibited AI practices
First AI Act rules (definition, AI literacy, prohibitions) applied from 2 February 2025
AI Act classifies systems into prohibited, high-risk and transparency-obligation categories
